Definition: a water-ox, i.e. the hippopotamus or Nile-horse
BiblicalUsage: 1) perhaps an extinct dinosaur; 1a) a Diplodocus or Brachiosaurus, exact meaning unknown; ++++; Some translate as elephant or hippopotamus but from the description in Job 40:15-24, this is patently absurd.
